messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Rule today (2024): Refund payable on cancellation by the Insured; time of cancellation depends on policy duration (e.g., one year, two year, three year, etc.).
Replaced rule (2020): The Insured may cancel this Policy by giving 15 days’ written notice, and the Company shall refund premium on short‑term rates for the unexpired policy period.
Existing questions: ['If I cancel my policy today, when will I get a refund and how is it calculated?', 'Does the insurer need to give me any notice period before cancelling my policy for fraud, and will I get any refund?']
Write 2 NEW, differently worded questions (e.g. a concrete scenario with a policyholder) whose correct answer today is the 2024 rule. JSON: {"questions": [str, str]}

content: {"questions":["I bought a two‑year health insurance plan last month and now want to cancel it; how long will it take to receive my refund and how is it worked out?","My policy has been active for three years and I’m thinking of ending it today; what refund am I entitled to and when will it be paid according to the current rules?"]}
